Collodi, G. (2010). Hydrogen production via steam reforming with CO2 capture. Chemical Engineering Transactions 19, 37-42. ISBN 978-88-95608-11-2. doi:10.3303/CET1019007

Locator: printed journal page numbers 37-42 (PDF page = printed - 36). Held copy is a SCAN with no text layer: OCR with tesseract at 300 dpi; every number used was checked against rendered page images (p.39, 41, 42). Author Guido Collodi, Foster Wheeler (Corsico, Milan); UKERC's raw form 'Collodi and Wheeler 2010' is a mis-parse of 'Collodi, Foster Wheeler'. Loaded: SMR CO2 balance per t H2 (Table 1, 100,000 Nm3/h plant: about 9 t CO2/t H2, split into process and combustion via the printed kmol/h); the two case-study capture options for a 150,000 Nm3/h SMR (Table 3) as capture-unit examples per t CO2 abated (incremental capex incl. compression to 150 barg, power, steam flow, NG change, capture rate, abatement-cost range, 25 yr, 5%) and host rows (share-to-capture = overall eta-CO2 of Table 2, captured CO2 per t H2). Conversions to per t H2 use 0.08988 kg/Nm3 (not printed). Not loaded: base-plant natural gas, steam export and electricity are NOT printed (Table 3 gives only deltas vs 'Base'), so no SMR energy intensity comes from this paper. Traps: price year not stated (2010 assumed); steam enthalpy not printed so steam stays a mass flow; capture 1 lowers NG use by 29 Gcal/h; capture-rate 100% is 'rounded off'.
